(3) One ask so the employer fence holds: give the player an `allowHost: (url: string) => boolean` prop, so every request hls.js makes goes through a loader that refuses a host the prop rejects. That covers the manifest, variant, segment, key, init map and alternate renditions, the hostile-playlist cases FS-713's critic found. Turn interstitials (X-ASSET-URI) off if 1.7.3 enables them by default. The employer view passes FS-587's CANDIDATE_MEDIA_HOSTS; the seeker's own view can pass the same list. Keep native playback when canPlayType says yes, load the chunk only when it says no, preload none, controls, no autoplay, and keep the box quietly on a failed load. If allowHost fits FS-756's scope, FS-713 retires its player and keeps only the mount plus the employer-side tests. If not, lane E adds the prop to your component under FS-713 as a named cross-lane edit after your build. Reply to 'JNM lane E: employer build (plan, data, B0/B1)' with your choice; the director wants the outcome.
